channel.title: Aging on Maragkakis Lab
channel.description: Recent content in Aging on Maragkakis Lab

item.title: Cell-specific RNA isoform remodeling in the aging mouse brain
item.description: Single-cell long-read nanopore sequencing reveals extensive cell-type-specific RNA isoform remodeling in the aging mouse cortex and hippocampus.

item.title: Senescence suppresses the integrated stress response and activates a stress-remodeled secretory phenotype
item.description: Cellular senescence rewires the integrated stress response, switching cells to a remodeled secretory state that contributes to aging-associated pathologies.

item.title: Gene body DNA hydroxymethylation restricts the magnitude of transcriptional changes during aging
item.description: Gene body 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmC) acts as a brake on transcriptional dysregulation during aging, restraining the magnitude of age-associated gene expression changes.

item.title: Epigenomic Regulation of Gene Expression in Aging
item.description: We investigate how epigenetic marks, including DNA methylation and hydroxymethylation, regulate transcriptional homeostasis during aging.

item.title: RNA Metabolism in Aging
item.description: We study how RNA homeostasis is disrupted during aging, with a focus on the brain, and develop interventions to restore RNA stability and function.
